text:
laura_marketing: Quick kickoff — need final SEO checklist for launch posts + webinar landing. can we freeze canonical owners today?

sam_seo: I can own canonical mapping. I'll push a first-pass sheet with column for "owner", "canonical", "redirect_priority". Aiming EOD.

jess_product: We also need a JSON-LD example for the webinar event + speakable excerpt. Any existing template we should follow?

sam_seo: Yep — Event + Breadcrumb + Organization. I'll paste a minimal example in the sheet and link to it.

laura_marketing: Internal linking plan: surface the new pillar from 3 high-traffic blog posts. Use targeted anchor text and one promotional banner on the blog index.

dan_growth: Redirect rules: priority buckets: high(301), medium(302 temp during QA), low(client-side). Preserve UTM params where possible. Example nginx rewrite:
```
# preserve utm and redirect permanently
rewrite ^/old-path/(.*)$ /new-path/$1? permanent; # 301
```

alex_ops: Heads up — redirects need a crawler pass on staging. I can run Screaming Frog Wed AM and export a CSV.

laura_marketing: Tracking: use utm_source=launch, utm_campaign=webinar_2026 for all promoted links. Also add campaign param to the registration CTA on the pillar.

sam_seo: Flagging a keyword gap: "inference cost optimization" should be a H2 + meta description variant. I'll add keyword suggestions and title options to the sheet.

jess_product: Messaging tweak for benchmark narrative: highlight latency vs cost trade-off in a single graph and add a customer quote about predictable latency.

laura_marketing: Action items — Sam: canonical sheet + JSON-LD examples. Alex: redirect QA + crawler report. Dan: implement redirect PR + UTM rules. Jess: update benchmark copy. I'll collate and prepare a PR for content merges.

sam_seo: Taking those. I'll upload the sheet to /launch/seo-assets and ping when ready :thumbsup:

alex_ops: Scheduling crawler and will share report by 2523457000.

dan_growth: Opening staging PR now with redirect rules and a small script to append UTM params when missing.

deploy-bot: Deployed branch launch-seo-redirects to staging at 2523456900 :rocket:

laura_marketing: Great work — quick sync tomorrow 10am PT to sign off on the final checklist. Thanks all :raised_hands:
